onset_detection.method: per-frame raw buffer equality against the clean bag; no threshold
onset_detection.note: the hard-coded 20.0 s was wrong; the injected span starts at 14.528393030166626 s, so six seconds of faulty frames had been treated as trusted The detector is an oracle: it needs the clean bag, so it is not evidence about online detection latency or recall. Raw-buffer difference means the bytes changed, not that every changed byte is the configured fault; the input hash chain covers identity.
onset_detection.segment_time_base: pre/quar, alignment windows and floor_ids all compare absolute header stamps; this run shares all 598 head frames, so the relative and absolute bases coincide (offset 0.0).
onset_detection.head_frame_offset_meaning: first paired scan minus first common scan = pairing delay at the head (not a bag-head difference)

caveats: Candidate is the host's own quarantined trajectory; the archive holds no repaired candidate for this window, so A3 can only accept or reject the host poses.
Incumbent is a constant-velocity extrapolation, not a per-frame record, so the paired test asks whether the candidate beats 'no repair', not whether it is optimal.
A0 and A2 write the identical keyframe set and therefore the same map; A2 differs only in having passed through quarantine before admitting everything.
ATE on the admitted set is confounded by coverage; ate_on_common_support is the like-for-like number.
The 120k-point proxy subsample inflates both contamination tails; at full proxy resolution the values are 0.2966 (A0) and 0.0029 (A1), and the 0.0079 floor is two-thirds sampling.

C_good attribution: the clean-scan control at the same reference scores median 16.2, so most of NIS 18.07 is the reference/alignment floor, not the un-stripped occluder; filtering the 4.0-4.6 m shell does not reduce it.

C_good attribution, gate protocol: clean control 14.90 vs raw 15.26 (the statistic is insensitive to the occluder); oracle sector removal 25.05 (fewer points, worse fit); budget 2400 gives 12.05, still >> 2.5. The reference/alignment construction dominates; no single cause.

C_good attribution: at 600 reference points the clean control is 18.75 vs raw 20.42; at 4000 it is 6.51 vs 7.72. The reference construction dominates; cap alone and occluder alone are both insufficient explanations.
The arm distance fields in this manifest are the 120k stride surface. A voxel-surface rerun (branch exp/four-arm, 762b533) gives 0.2969/0.0029; see voxel_surface_check.
evidence_status_scope: evidence_status describes the paired-benefit term only; the holdout-NIS term is reported separately as holdout_nis, and accepted=False means the candidate did not enter Mode 2.

time_bases.meaning: head_frame_offset_sec = first paired scan - first common scan, i.e. the pairing delay at the head, not a difference between the two bags' heads. The clean run's first paired scan is 1627785263.58389 (head dropped [0,2.4] s).
time_bases.method: measured by re-running pair_keyframes on the archived bags after the 3eb9408 review; the earlier zero values were hand-filled and wrong
time_bases.note: Segment membership (pre/quar, alignment windows, floor_ids) uses absolute header stamps, so this pairing delay does not shift any segment; it only means the first paired keyframe is 1.30 s after the first raw scan.

recomputed_matches_archive.note: own nearest-neighbour implementation, no sampling; identical to 4 decimals

proxy_resolution.note: the 120k stride subsample inflates both tails; about two-thirds of the reported 0.0079 floor is proxy sampling rather than map error

independent_check.independent_maps: A0 equals A2 and A1 equals A3 (the gate rejected the candidate, so verified admission degenerates to quarantine). Only the A0-vs-A1 comparison is independent; the floor is a third copy of A1.
independent_check.interpretation: The contamination gap is consistent with the archived 12.9 m post-window trajectory residual: 'the written map is far from the clean surface' and 'the host trajectory drifted' are two descriptions of one fact. Report it as a consistency check, not as independent evidence for the admission policy.

good_candidate_attribution.statistic: fixed frame set: gate committable keys (259), every 5th (52), mean
good_candidate_attribution.query_population_note: raw scan vs sector-removed scan vs clean scan are different point sets; differences mix observation and query sampling and are not a controlled causal attribution
good_candidate_attribution.oracle_removal: azimuth <= 2.3876 rad removed only inside the injection window (88% of the circle)
good_candidate_attribution.reading: At the gate's 600-point budget the clean-scan control scores 18.75 against the raw candidate's 20.42, so the gate's 18.07 is dominated by the reference scale; the occluder adds about 1.7 NIS. At 4000 points the clean control is still 6.51 and raw 7.72, so raising the cap does not make the statistic usable either: the blocking factor is the reference/alignment construction, not the cap and not the occluder. The query populations differ between variants (raw, sector-removed, clean), so this is a sensitivity, not a pure occlusion effect.

voxel_surface_check.why: the 120k stride proxy in this manifest keeps 1.4% of 8.49M clean points and inflates every distance; the branch reruns with a 5 cm voxel surface and reports both surfaces
voxel_surface_check.reading: at full spatial coverage the A0/A1 tail gap is 0.2969 vs 0.0029; the 120k floor 0.0079 is about two-thirds sampling. The main manifest keeps the 120k fields it was generated with; the voxel values are this branch's rerun and are not merged into the arm rows.
